units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 16b:5">B. Kam. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>למימרא דט׳ לאו וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>דטריפא</he>, Ms. M. <he>דטָרַף</he>, ref. to the preceding <he>טרף ואכל</he>) does that mean to say that tearing is not his (the lion’s) habit?

senses.gloss: being carried away by waves, being cast ashore.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 16:4:4">Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᵈ</cite> top <he>נותנין … כדי ט׳</he> the court allows a reasonable time sufficient for the discovery of an eventual escape of the husband by being cast ashore.

senses.gloss: (denom. of טֶרֶף) covering with leaves, night cover in open air.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 119:1">Yalk. Gen. 119</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00564"><he>רְטִיבָה</he></cite>.
